nameOrigin: oval object in which animals develop

pokedexEntries.rb: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

pokedexEntries.ye: The heads attract each other and spin around. There must be 6 heads for it to maintain balance.

pokedexEntries.go: The shell is very durable. Even if it cracks, it can survive without spilling the contents.

pokedexEntries.si: Using telepathy only they can receive, they always form a cluster of six EXEGGCUTE.

pokedexEntries.cr: If even one is separated from the group, the energy bond between the six will make them rejoin instantly.

pokedexEntries.rs: This POKéMON consists of six eggs that form a closely knit cluster. The six eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear on the eggs, EXEGGCUTE is close to evolution.

pokedexEntries.fr: Even though it appears to be eggs of some sort, it was discovered to be a life-form more like plant seeds.

pokedexEntries.lg: It is often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

pokedexEntries.em: It consists of six eggs that care for each other. The eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear, it is close to evolution.

pokedexEntries.dpp: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

pokedexEntries.hg: Their shells are very durable. Even if they crack, they can survive without spilling their contents.

pokedexEntries.ss: Using telepathy only they can employ, they always form a cluster of six EXEGGCUTE.

pokedexEntries.bw: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

pokedexEntries.x: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

pokedexEntries.y: Even though it appears to be eggs of some sort, it was discovered to be a life-form more like plant seeds.

pokedexEntries.oras: This Pokémon consists of six eggs that form a closely knit cluster. The six eggs attract each other and spin around. When cracks increasingly appear on the eggs, Exeggcute is close to evolution.

pokedexEntries.su: Its six eggs use telepathy to communicate among themselves. It is believed to carry plant genes and the genes of other species.

pokedexEntries.mo: Six of them together form a full-fledged Pokémon. It’s often hunted by Crabrawler, but uses psychokinesis to drive it off.

pokedexEntries.us: Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.

pokedexEntries.um: Although they are the same size as other Exeggcute, the ones produced in Alola are quite heavy. Their shells are packed full.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: The heads attract each other and spin around. There must be six heads for it to maintain balance.

pokedexEntries.sw: Though it may look like it’s just a bunch of eggs, it’s a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

pokedexEntries.sh: These Pokémon get nervous when they’re not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

pokedexEntries.sc: If you touch one of Exeggcute’s heads, mistaking it for an egg, the other heads will quickly gather and attack you in a swarm.

pokedexEntries.vi: Using telepathy only fellow Exeggcute can pick up on, they always form a cluster of six.
